required_volumes.name: Proposal Cover Sheet
required_volumes.controls: Public-safe abstract and benefits fields; firm and proposal certifications apply.

required_volumes.name: Technical Proposal
required_volumes.controls: Maximum 10 pages; 10-point minimum body text; one-inch margins; six-month Base and six-month Option.

required_volumes.name: Cost Volume
required_volumes.controls: Base must not exceed $200,000; Option must not exceed $115,000; Base and Option separated; proposing SBC performs at least two-thirds of each; no cost sharing.

required_volumes.name: Company Commercialization Report
required_volumes.controls: A current SBIR.gov CCR PDF is conditionally required for firms with prior Phase I or Phase II SBIR/STTR awards.

required_volumes.name: Supporting Documents
required_volumes.controls: Applicability review is required for DD Form 2345 or application evidence, majority-owned investment certification, joint-venture eligibility, TABA detail, data-rights assertions, and a fundamental-research disclosure. Technical-merit overflow is not allowed.

required_volumes.name: Fraud, Waste, and Abuse Training
required_volumes.controls: The Proposal Owner must complete the required annual review in DSIP.

required_volumes.name: Disclosures of Foreign Affiliations or Relationships to Foreign Countries
required_volumes.controls: The webform must be completed and submitted; a PDF upload is not accepted as a substitute.

topic_controls: Projected CMMC Level 2 (Self) requirement must be met before award
The topic is restricted under ITAR or EAR and requires a controlled foreign-national and export review
A current NIST SP 800-171 assessment in SPRS is required to be considered for award
Advanced phases carry U.S.-ownership, foreign-influence mitigation, facility-clearance, and personnel-clearance conditions

eligibility.requirement: The proposing entity qualifies as an eligible small business concern under 13 CFR 121.702.
A valid SBA Company Registry SBC Control ID and proof of registration are available for DSIP.
SAM registration and representations are current; an active registration is required at award.
The firm, Firm Admin, Proposal Owner, and Corporate Official have current DSIP access and authority.
The principal investigator's primary employment is with the proposing SBC at award and during performance.
The proposing SBC performs at least two-thirds of Phase I work in both the Base and Option.
The SBC and subcontractors perform all research and development work in the United States.
The projected CMMC Level 2 (Self), NIST SP 800-171, and SPRS conditions can be met before award.
ITAR or EAR handling, foreign-national disclosure, and applicable DD Form 2345 evidence are complete and accurate.
The later-phase U.S.-ownership, foreign-influence mitigation, facility-clearance, and personnel-clearance path is supportable.
